[NDBG.6.1] The DS DAP debug adapter (`ds dap`) is the reference consumer of
this surface. It exposes the calls as DAP custom requests —
`ds/getJustifiers` (→ `get_justifiers`, NDBG.14.3),
`ds/getReteNetwork` (→ `rete_network`),
`ds/getMatchTrace` (→ `rete_match_trace`), and
`ds/getRefractedActivations` (→ `refracted_activations`, NDBG.14.12) —
and gates the pause-only reads on its tracked stopped state. An integrator
building its own inspector calls the same engine APIs directly; an integrator
already running the DS DAP adapter gets this surface over DAP without writing C.
